channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Russia tells diplomats to leave Kyiv in case Moscow launches mass strikes
item.description: Moscow threatens retaliatory strikes if Ukraine attacks Russia during Victory Day commemorations.

item.title: Trump says had ‘very good talks’ with Iran as Tehran reviews US proposal
item.description: Momentum could be building for Washington and Tehran to strike a deal that could ultimately end the war.

item.title: Israeli strike kills colonel in Gaza police force, say Palestinian medics
item.description: At least 17 others wounded in a targeted attack on Naseem al-Kalazani's vehicle in western Khan Younis city.

item.title: Why are Pentagon officials talking about Iran’s ‘deadly dolphins’?
item.description: Soraya Lennie discusses false claims about Iran using marine life in warfare.

item.title: Iran ‘has attained an elevated international standing’ says FM
item.description: The Iranian foreign minister said Iran has ‘attained an elevated international standing’ during the war.

item.title: Israel bombs Beirut’s southern suburb as it targets Hezbollah commander
item.description: It was the first attack on Beirut's southern suburbs since a truce in the Israel-Hezbollah war went into force on April 17.

item.title: Four killed in post-election violence in India’s West Bengal
item.description: Unrest grips the key eastern state after Modi's Hindu nationalist BJP wins the state election for the first time.

item.title: Oil prices drop and stock markets rise after reports of deal to end Iran war
item.description: Reports have raised hopes of an agreement between the US and Iran after days of escalation.

item.title: China calls for Strait to be reopened 'as soon as possible' in Iran talks
item.description: Wang Yi is holding talks with Iran's foreign minister Aragchi who is on his first trip to China since the war began.

item.title: BBC traces how 10 minutes of Israeli bombing brought devastation to Lebanon
item.description: The bombs started falling at 14:15 in the afternoon - bringing chaos and destruction across the country.
